tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground: birch-paper off-white. Behind everything.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: The rare raised surface: code blocks, the editor canvas, menus.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Inset wells: inputs, inline code, image placeholders. Dry-grass beige.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy: basalt with a moss undertone. 14.6:1 on paper (light), 14.8:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, descriptions, captions, nav at rest. 6.2:1 on paper (light), 7.7:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Non-text marks only: disabled icons, strong hairline. ≥3.2:1 on paper; never body text.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px rules between rows and sections. Carries no meaning.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Quiet decorative marks: lichen grey-green. Atmosphere only.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Moss. Links on hover, the scanline, your own presence, the one highlighted word. 5.6:1 on paper (light), 9.5:1 (dark).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Glacier-water focus ring, solid 2px offset 2px. ≥5.4:1 on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Body fill of the liquid glass material, over the refracted backdrop.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: Specular rim highlight on the light-facing edge of glass.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Shadow-side inner edge of glass that separates it from the paper.

tokens.name: presence-1
tokens.usage: Visitor color 1 — moss. Trails, globe pins and chips only.

tokens.name: presence-2
tokens.usage: Visitor color 2 — glacier.

tokens.name: presence-3
tokens.usage: Visitor color 3 — lupine.

tokens.name: presence-4
tokens.usage: Visitor color 4 — puffin beak.

tokens.name: presence-5
tokens.usage: Visitor color 5 — sulfur.

tokens.name: presence-6
tokens.usage: Visitor color 6 — rhubarb. All six hold ≥3.6:1 on paper as marks.

tokens.name: tint-moss
tokens.usage: Card and atmosphere tint. Fresh moss, pale. Quiet enough that ink and ink-muted keep AA on it.

tokens.name: tint-lichen
tokens.usage: Card and atmosphere tint. Grey-green lichen on warm stone. Quiet enough that ink and ink-muted keep AA on it.

tokens.name: tint-glacier
tokens.usage: Card and atmosphere tint. Glacial meltwater, milky. Quiet enough that ink and ink-muted keep AA on it.

tokens.name: tint-sand
tokens.usage: Card and atmosphere tint. Black-sand beach dried to beige. Quiet enough that ink and ink-muted keep AA on it.

tokens.name: tint-fjord
tokens.usage: Card and atmosphere tint. Cold sea light. Quiet enough that ink and ink-muted keep AA on it.

tokens.name: tint-birch
tokens.usage: Card and atmosphere tint. Birch bark, the neutral. Quiet enough that ink and ink-muted keep AA on it.

styles.name: display-name
styles.usage: The name on the home page, nowhere else. The only size outside the four-step scale. Fluid: it fills the column from 44px (phone) to 136px.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section and page headings (Selected work, Writing, About) and the article title. Display face.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card headings (Experience, Publications), project and post titles on tiles, rows and page-end links, article h2, the lede. Display face.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Creative developer with experience in AI, web and systems.
styles.usage: Paragraphs, descriptions, list rows, nav links, buttons, article prose. Item titles inside a card (employer, publication, hackathon, press, award, page-end link) are body at 500.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Not a fifth size: body at weight 500. Item titles, nav links, buttons, article h3.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta: dates, years, roles, venue lines, captions, labels, footers, tertiary text. Ink-muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code only: the small size in mono.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, dot grid pitch at its densest.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Glass button padding (block).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; glass button padding (inline).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between title and meta in a project row.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; project row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs groups and figures in articles.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Top of the name header to the first section.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Image plates nested inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, inline code, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Images and figures in articles.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards. Apple newsroom tiles are 24px on phones and 32px on desktop; 28px (radius-lg) is used at 900px and up.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass panels: nav bar, editor toolbar, floating menus.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Glass buttons and the nav pill.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Under every liquid glass surface. The only drop shadow in the system.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Everything that is not glass: rows, images, the header. Paper is flat.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Frost behind glass, applied after refraction.

tokens.name: glass-refraction
tokens.usage: feDisplacementMap scale at the rim of a 28px-radius panel; scale with radius.

tokens.name: glass-saturate
tokens.usage: Backdrop saturation boost so color under glass reads vivid, as Apple's material does.

meta.note: michal.ai — paper and nature: Icelandic palette (birch paper, basalt ink, moss), serif-forward editorial type, sans display, mono only for code, Apple-style liquid glass, out-of-focus flower backdrop; Michelangelus display.
